card.title: The *story*
card.text: On 1 November 2011 at the GSP Stadium, Aílton put APOEL ahead from the penalty spot in the first half. Hulk levelled from the spot a minute from time. Then, in the 90th minute, Gustavo Manduca met captain Constantinos Charalambides' cross: APOEL 2, Porto 1, and APOEL top of Group G on 8 points.

caption:
From the archive: 1 November 2011, Nicosia. ⚽

15 years ago this Sunday, Gustavo Manduca scored in the 90th minute to give APOEL a 2-1 win over Porto at the GSP Stadium and keep them top of their Champions League group.

Three weeks later APOEL became the first Cypriot club to reach the Champions League knockout stage, and in March they beat Lyon on penalties to reach the quarter-finals.

Were you at the GSP that night? 🇨🇾

Source: UEFA, AP

alt: Archive cover, 1 November 2011: APOEL's 90th-minute night. Gustavo Manduca's late winner against Porto kept APOEL top of their Champions League group. 15 years ago.

The story: on 1 November 2011 at the GSP Stadium, Aílton scored a first-half penalty for APOEL, Hulk equalised from the spot a minute from time, and Gustavo Manduca won it in the 90th minute from captain Constantinos Charalambides' cross: APOEL 2, Porto 1, top of Group G on 8 points.
The match: UEFA Champions League, Group G, Tuesday 1 November 2011, GSP Stadium, Nicosia: APOEL 2, Porto 1. Goals: Aílton (penalty) and Manduca for APOEL, Hulk (penalty) for Porto.

What came next: 23 November 2011, Zenit 0-0 APOEL, the first Cypriot club in the Champions League knockouts; 7 March 2012, Lyon beaten on penalties, the first Cypriot quarter-finalist; quarter-final against Real Madrid lost 8-2 on aggregate.
End card: more from the archive every Tuesday and Thursday.
